reason: Machine lens: all opcodes real on the 65SC12 (TAY, STY zp, SBC (zp) is the 65C02 zp-indirect mode, 5 cycles, no page penalty). Recount: old prologue LDA zp 3, SEC 2, SBC 3, BEQ 2, STA 3, TAX 2, LDA zp 3, STA zp 3, SEC 2 = 23 plus LDA &CE 3 per column; new LDA 3, TAY 2, SEC 2, SBC 3, BEQ 2, STA 3, TAX 2, STY zp 3, SEC 2, LDA &CE 3 = 25 once. Saving 3n-2 cycles for n>=1 columns (1 cycle at n=1 plus the hoist's 3(n-1)); BEQ exit path +2 (TAY). A after STA &CE equals the new &CE and BCS/DEC &CF/SEC/DEX/BNE leave A alone, so the hoist holds; exits return the same A (0 on BEQ, &CE low on loop end), Y (LDY &CE) and X. Bytes: -2 (LDA edge_x_low) +1 (TAY) = -1. Built the candidate in a scratch copy and diffed listings against the unmodified build: same line count, everything from &1C55 to &333F moves down 1 (absorbed by the SKIP unused_3400_original), all ASSERTs pass; in the new code BEQ &1C50->&1C67, BCS and BNE (&1C64->&1C5B) stay on page &1C. Over the whole moved region no branch starts or stops crossing a page; no indexed base moved from LO=&00 to &FF (every moved table base goes down by 1, so page crossings for non-negative indexes can only fall); sky_room moves &3001->&3000, still >= &3000 (ASSERTed). No entry past these labels, no store to their operands, all references symbolic.
